parameters.description:
`msg-to-lametric` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your LaMetric device — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own LaMetric devices — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional LaMetric devices bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment LaMetric destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your LaMetric device API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own LaMetric device by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's LAMETRIC_BASE_URL value (same format as LAMETRIC_BASE_URL)

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's LAMETRIC_BASIC value (same format as LAMETRIC_BASIC)
